An '''ultra-high-density household communication screen''' was a communications device which displayed an ultra-high-density two-dimensional image of the individual at the other end of a conversation. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had two of them in his [[Han Solo's sky house|sky house]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
